dimensions.question: Can a first-time reader explain why a sparse cheap ask is not automatically the best route?
Does the README name the price ladder, supply weighting, policy, and adapter boundary concretely?
Are ranking, reliability, and availability claims bounded by repository evidence?
Can a reader find the promise, mechanism, proof, and next action quickly?
Do the generated anime-inspired hero and supporting banner clarify the price/supply/evidence trade-off without implying live guarantees?
Do the visuals and Markdown remain useful when stacked on a narrow screen?

decision_rule: Accept only when claim_safety passes and no weighted dimension is below 3/5; human review remains authoritative for whether the story is ready to share.
